# Version 4.157.0
> **Raster and GPU readback reliability** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.157.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.157.0 previews Skia m157 with path rasterization, GPU clipping and readback corrections. The line also makes the cdecl convention explicit on generated LibraryImport declarations. HarfBuzzSharp's .200 package revision still bundles native HarfBuzz 14.4.0.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia m157** — Updates the bundled renderer to milestone 157 while preserving existing managed wrappers and C exports. Graphite Metal uses iOS/tvOS 15 and macOS 12 runtime minimums. ([#5542](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5542))

## Bug Fixes

- **Path and glyph replay correctness** — Corrects clipped convex anti-aliased path rasterization, device-space bounds and coverage-mask clamping. Validates direct-mask Slug data and replay, fixes Graphite clip keys and wedge inflation, and initializes Vulkan render-pass pointers. ([#5630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5630), [#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612))
- **Complete Graphite RGBx readback** — Corrects the pixel-size and row-stride mismatch when transferring alpha textures into RGBx destinations so destination bytes are not left unwritten. ([#5630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5630))
- **Explicit LibraryImport calling convention** — Generated LibraryImport declarations now specify cdecl, matching the existing DllImport and delegate paths. This corrects an ABI mismatch relevant to Windows x86; runtime verification of the reported optimized-call stack-growth symptom remains outstanding. ([#5565](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5565))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.200

Generated HarfBuzz LibraryImport declarations now explicitly specify cdecl to match the existing import and delegate paths. The .200 package revision does not upgrade the native HarfBuzz 14.4.0 engine.

## Preview 1 (November 6, 2026)

Introduced Skia m157 with raster, glyph-replay, GPU-clipping and Graphite readback corrections. Generated LibraryImport declarations now explicitly use cdecl.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.156.0-rc.1.26553.11...v4.157.0-preview.1.26556.1)
